summary: Official Karnataka/Udupi land-record custody and DILRMP cadastral-status evidence were found, but no anonymous Udupi parcel ID-plus-polygon response was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Kannada discovery queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-9229-udupi.json. The official Udupi District page identifies local land-record officials; DILRMP search evidence reports Udupi cadastral-map status; the Karnataka API help page documents a survey-number route. These establish custody and service context, not open citywide parcel geometry.
requestOutcomes: The Karnataka survey-number service and land-record host timed out under bounded anonymous GET attempts. The DILRMP status route returned a gateway failure and the NAKSHA page timed out. No login, credentials, private token, unsafe field request, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or TLS disablement was used.
